items.title: Alvin Alcorn Interview, 1976-01-25
items.q: See, back in those days we had blues singers like Bessie Smith. Ma Rainey.

ctx.x: She was that same kind of natural though as an artist, don't you?
I came through with that. But the one that said everything was Bessie Smith and other people. See, back in those days we had blues singers like Bessie Smith. Ma Rainey.
